title: neottopteris curtisorus
intro: Neottopteris curtisorus, commonly known as the mountain fern, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Southeast Asia, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of Neottopteris curtisorus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. Further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and potential side effects of using Neottopteris curtisorus as a medicinal plant.
